title:
The async effect to place all pending sensor settings changes into Reliability.ReliabilityApplicationState
See {@link Sensor#updateMonitorSettings} and {@link Sensor#updateOperatingStatusSettings}.

This epic will get input from the state of:
- `Reliability.ChangeSensorMonitorSettingsModalList_dataSpec_ds` for a list of sensor ids
- `Reliability.ChangeSensorMonitorSettingsModalForm` for a list of alert flags, and the updatesEnabled toggle state
- `Reliability.ChangeSensorSettingsModalOperationalStatusForm` for operational status and duration

For additional field details see {@link SensorSettingsModalConfigData}

This Epic will open a confirmation modal only if `Reliability.ChangeSensorMonitorSettingsModalForm.operationalStatus` has some value.
name: SetSensorSettingsStateEpic
